author_findings.statement: The sampled streams showed greater and steadier concurrent viewership on weekends, especially some afternoons; magnitude is not a universal platform estimate
Shorter sampled streams had higher and more stable concurrency; longer streams often developed viewership more gradually with more variance

limitations: Five-minute snapshots of simultaneous viewers are not unique people, whole-broadcast view events, total watch hours or audience retention cohorts.
Dataset selection is not a census of worldwide YouTube streams or creator earnings and covers only May–June 2024.
A 120-minute broadcast is not a 120-minute average viewing session for any viewer.
Weekday/weekend and length observations are associational; channel sizes, programming and creator schedules may confound patterns.
No experimental best upload time, individual watch behavior, 2026 audience growth or revenue conversion is measured.
Hashed stream IDs and the author's aggregate public observations must not be used to reconstruct individual viewer histories.
